modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Install the elements in different layers of industrial network architecture and protocols

pcs.pc_description: identify the devices and systems to be connected in the IIOT network
analyse the installed machines, automation elements, system, and robots into different layers of network architecture like field devices, control devices, network etc.
interpret the network consists of network devices, automation systems and robots
support the engineer in installation of the suitable network protocols like MODBUS, CC-LINK, Profinet, Profibus, OPC UA, MQTT etc. as per the control system requirements
connect the intelligent devices and system using suitable network topology like STAR, LINE, RING as per network design document and Engineer instructions
evaluate the impacts of IIOT network on the environment and humans

modules.module_title: Integrate and establish communication using I/O link master and network protocols

pcs.pc_description: install and connect the automation elements like PLC, VFD, HMI, Pneumatics, Hydraulics Elements, Industrial sensors, IIOT Sensors, control devices to I/O link master via I/O link Devices as per SOP and Engineer instructions
support in installation of the cable between devices as per the signaling parameters like bend radius, signal ground, terminal resistor, cable length etc.
establish the communication between automation system, intelligent devices, and robots by doing parameter setting like baud rate, distance, station ID and station type
support in setting the network parameters of automation system on the device manufacturers software as per SOP and organizational guidelines
turn on the power of automation devices, system in the network and look for healthy communication between them
ensure physical security of the network contains I/O Link, I/O Link Master, IIOT Sensors, machines, robots and automation system
protect the network from unauthorized access or malicious internet by following organizational guidelines
ensure that only authorized devices should be able to connect to the network
support in conducting the trials of system as per the e-plan and align it with the existing or new manufacturing process
handover the system to production team & support the engineer to provide them training on its use and operation as per organizational guidelines and procedures
prepare documents and records as a reference for future development as per Engineer instructions
